title: Ali sa bhi na koi aadile zamana hua
body:
Ali Sa Bhi Na Koi Aadil –E- Zamana Huwa
Ke ek Baaz–O- Kabutar Ka Ashiyana Huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Maki'n Rahe Na Makaa'n, Tarfa Kaarkhana Huwa
Zami'n Ulat Gayi Kya Munqalib Zamana Huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Andheri Qabr Thi Aur Mai Tha Ya Ali Wali
Huzoor Aaye To Roushan Siyah Khana Huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Raha Na Koi Bahathtar Me Zohar Tak Baaqi
Hussain Rehgaye Aur Qafela Rawana Huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Mila Na Asghar –E- Nadaa'n Ko Jaam Paani Ka
Surahi Daar Gala Teer Ka Nashana Huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Firaaq –E- Shaah Ka Sadmaa Utha Sakina Se
Qalaq Se Jaan Gayi, Mout Ka Bahana Huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhatak Ke Raah Me Peeche Kahi'n Na Reh Jaau'n
Utho Anees Utho Khafela Rawana Hua
